Professional Profile

Safety is not paperwork.
It's prevention.

I'm a Safety Officer based in Punjab, Pakistan, with construction and infrastructure experience at NESPAK, TMT, and M. Saddique Ch & Co.

My day-to-day centres on permit-to-work systems, job safety analysis, site-level risk assessment, worker inductions and practical HSE monitoring.

I'm currently working through a BS degree alongside my HSE certifications and am actively looking for Safety Officer or HSE opportunities in Saudi Arabia, the UAE, Qatar and other Gulf markets.

01 — Identify Recognise hazards before work starts.
02 — Control Apply practical controls at site level.
03 — Prevent Build safer habits and working conditions.
